record.question: During which Five Year Plan was the annual growth rate of National Income lowest?
record.explanation: Among the Five Year Plans, the Third Plan (1961-66) recorded the lowest realised growth of national income, about 2.8% per year against a target of around 5.6%, so option (b) is correct.
